Perform the actual closure (Existing top-opening hinged-lid tuck carton; actual one-handed tuck action requires a trial.) with the right hand and the declared permitted supports. Force, peeling, flap springback and simultaneous palm/finger actions remain unverified.

Hinged-lid flap sweep is assumed free of exterior corner stops; stops stay outside parcel and lid travel is untested.
Insert outer footprint 161x118 mm is assumed to fit inside 180x135 mm carton with room for card; actual fit untested.
Cardboard tray springback and wall stability at 15 mm walls are assumed to retain shape; untested.
Friction and stability of carton on station and insert in carton during one-handed loading are assumed sufficient; untested.
One-handed hinged-lid tuck closure with contents supported on station is assumed possible; requires trial.
Finished carton removal between 20 mm corner stops without lifting interference is assumed possible; untested.
Station reset to clear state is assumed sufficient; no validation claimed.

output.title: Notebook and card in tuck carton with low tray and corner stops
output.summary: Pack notebook and card into existing hinged-lid carton using prepared 15 mm tray and low corner stops, right hand only.
output.rationale: Lightweight notebook 148x105x12 in 180x135x35 top-opening carton allows low 15 mm retaining tray with 5 mm clearance for easy one-handed loading. Outer insert about 161x118 leaves side room for loose card. Corner stops at minimal 20 mm height stay outside parcel below carton top, leaving lid travel free and permitting extraction. Station at offset 100,100 centers carton at 217.5,195 within reach. Least burdensome cardboard-only proposal; all physical behavior untested.
